# bs_score — Grok Bot

Wrapper for **Grok Bot**. Canonical skill and scorer:
[alexhawat/bs_score](https://github.com/alexhawat/bs_score).

Attach the root `SKILL.md` as the bot skill, or copy this folder into the bot's skills library.

Scoring needs no clone:

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/alexhawat/bs_score bs-score findings.json --repo-root .
```
